# awscc_glue_data_quality_ruleset (Data Source)

Data Source schema for AWS::Glue::DataQualityRuleset



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies the resource.

### Read-Only

- `client_token` (String) A unique token for idempotency.
- `description` (String) A description of the data quality ruleset.
- `name` (String) A unique name for the data quality ruleset.
- `ruleset` (String) A Data Quality Definition Language (DQDL) ruleset.
- `tags` (Map of String) A map of key-value pairs to apply to this resource.
- `target_table` (Attributes) An object representing an AWS Glue table. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--target_table))
